description: Retrospective application for the erection of two single storey outbuildings and cricket net and change of use of land to Residential (C3)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Planning Statement], [Unnumbered Location Plan], [377-EXT-02], Received: 19/01/2022; [Fire Statement], [377-ext-01-Fire], Received: 11/04/2022; [377-EXT-01], [377-EXT-03], Received: 26/07/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - Outbuilding to be incidental
Within three months of the date of permission, the toilet facilities shown on the initially submitted plans must be removed and the outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used for the purpose as a gym/store/utility and playroom or for any other purpose incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 103 Syon Park Gardens, TW7 5NF and not as a self-contained dwelling nor as a business premises, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom, toilet or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
